conclusion: We presented [math] -World, a generative multi-agent world model for interactive simulation beyond two players. [math] -World combines Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding for distinct yet permutation-symmetric agent identities with Sparse Hub Attention for efficient hub-mediated cross-agent communication. Together with conditional teacher–student distillation and KV-cached streaming inference, these components enable real-time action-responsive rollouts that remain consistent across time and agent perspectives. Experiments in multiplayer virtual environments show that [math] -World improves fidelity, controllability, and inter-agent consistency over baselines.
